name: doc-appointment
description: Enterprise Doctor Appointment & Healthcare Platform - MERN Stack

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN" -c "blue.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix Backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix admin run lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build
